instructions:
# CP-DR — Enel instrument-document discovery

Run the exact single question in RESEARCH_enel-final-terms-research-001.json.
The brief, inclusion/exclusion ledger and source-method hashes are locked before
new discovery. Same host has the earlier Enel preflight context; disclose it.
Use public web search and retain actual original source bytes when accessible.
One focused initial discovery and at most two named-gap loops. Keep search logs,
document identity, originating evidence families and failed access honestly.

Workstream W1: issuer/creditor document perspective; hypothesis that an official
instrument-specific Final Terms file supplies missing calendar/elections.
Disconfirm by matching ISIN, issuer, currency, coupon and maturity; a programme
document or a different tranche cannot satisfy this test. The adversarial lane
checks original identity/date, later-outcome contamination, extractability and
whether contractual dates alone establish actual step/payment (they do not).
The synthesis lane answers only the frozen question and its downstream use.

Use the selected CP-DR question/evidence/finding schemas without changing the
question denominator. Preserve source locators, dates, units and uncertainty.
Current project six headings Request/Sources/Findings/Calculations/Gaps/Next
module govern transport; old M365 invocation/navigation/Markdown-as-completion
requirements are not inherited. This is standalone external research, not a
fabricated same-run native handoff. A receiving analytical module must actually
read and admit or reject it, citing its hash and explaining what changes.

Research cannot supply an unsupported legal conclusion or issuer outcome.
No new runtime, source alteration, credential, provider, agent or Excel output.
Separate delivery must publish the actual checked handoff using existing code.
